request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:JUGGERNAUT

layers.text: Recolour and change nothing else: every mint green crystal chunk of the golem becomes a block of black liquorice #23192b, with paler #5a4c6e facets and white highlights; the brown bands at its joints become bright stripes of pink #ff8fc0, white and lemon yellow #ffe04a; its face becomes white sugar with dark eyes; the crest on its head is bright pink crystal. No green and no brown is left. Keep every shape, the pose, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
